title: Container Bookings: when shipping instructions count as late
content:
## Rule
Under the Container Bookings product line, shipping instructions are late when the receipt moment recorded on the booking is later than the booking's SI cut-off; received on time, they book nothing.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical times)
*Hypothetical SI cut-off of 12:00 on 3 May, for illustration only:*
| Receipt moment recorded on the booking | Later than the cut-off | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 11:45 on 3 May | no | on time; nothing is booked |
| 12:00 on 3 May | no | on time; nothing is booked |
| 12:01 on 3 May | yes | late |

## Points of judgement
**The shipper says the instructions were sent before the cut-off.** Lateness is judged on the receipt moment recorded on the booking.
